column3: web tests own their globals and module state: web/test/globals.ts stubGlobals installs each file's own stubs in beforeAll and restores the exact descriptors in afterAll, deleting any that were absent; files whose modules read window at import (tabs, onboarding, plugin-detail, skill-detail, integration-row) import them in beforeAll; api, cmd and socket tests restore descriptors after each test instead of reassigning values; onboarding resets with loadProgress before each test; context.test gives each test its own conversation ids
column4: Under bun test --randomize, a warm context cache (conv 3) and an already-set firstCaptain broke two tests. Globals installed at module top level leaked whenever a -t filter skipped every test in a file, because afterAll does not run then, and the location-less window tabs.test left behind made router.ts fail its import, an error ESM caches for every later importer. Reassigning a saved undefined left an own property behind
